distribution: Manzhuang, Mengla, Yunnan, 600 m above sea level.
soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal third yellow, labrum pale yellow, antennae milky white, pronotum, abdomen and legs almost milky white. Head densely covered with fine short hairs, the labrum with a pair of apical hairs, its surface with seven to eight pairs of long and short hairs in longitudinal rows. Head elongate-oval, narrow in the anterior part and rounded in the posterior part, widest at the middle, the posterolateral margins broadly rounded; in lateral view the head raised like a mound in front of the middle. Labrum lanceolate, widest at the base. The inner margin of the middle of the left mandible slightly arched, with a minute tooth in front of the basal tooth; right mandible slightly more slender than the left. The middle of the anterior margin of the postmentum slightly concave, widest at the middle. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 4 shortest, segment 2 half as long again as segment 4. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave in the middle, the posterior margin slightly concave.
